conservador.note: Phase1 ~4% CAGR, Phase2 declining to 2.5%, terminal g=2.5%, WACC 7.0%. Beauty market matures, China/travel-retail soft, FX headwinds persist; record margins hold but top-line slows. PV equity ~EUR 154B incl. ~EUR 2B net cash.

optimista.note: Phase1 ~8% CAGR, Phase2 declining to 3.5%, terminal g=3.0%. Dermatological Beauty + Luxe re-acceleration, China recovery, margin expansion toward gross-margin records. PV equity ~EUR 217B.

multiple_rationale: 5y avg fwd P/E ~35.7x reflects COVID-era premium multiples that have structurally normalized. Apply a deliberate haircut to ~31x (about 13% below the 5y mean, above today's 27.2x) to reflect a lower-for-longer growth regime (mid-single-digit organic vs 2018-21 highs), China/travel-retail softness, and FX drag — but NOT a broken franchise: net cash, record 74.3% gross margin and 20.2% operating margin in FY2025, 35+ years of growth, ROIC ~13.5%. A premium-but-trimmed multiple is warranted for a proven, defensive consumer compounder.
structural_change: No structural impairment — this is multiple normalization, not deterioration. FY2025 hit record gross margin (74.3%) and operating margin (20.2%); Q1 2026 organic re-accelerated to +7.6% LFL (beat). De-rating from peak ~35x to ~27x fwd P/E reflects post-COVID growth-regime reset and FX/China cyclicality, with Kering Beaute (closed Mar 31 2026) adding ~1.5pp perimeter. Franchise quality (net cash, ~13.5% ROIC, decades of compounding) intact.
